title: Component envelope (docs/content-model.md#components)
description: A component's fixed keys: an entry's envelope without summary, description, tags, or image, since it has no card and is read only on its parent's page. `stats` is validated by the ruleset's schema for the component type.

type.description: The component type, listed under `components` in the ruleset's ruleset.json, such as "class-feature".

id.description: The parent's id, a hyphen, and the slug of the name, with the level added where the parent prints the name twice. Equal to the file name, and never changed after merge.

name.description: Display name, unique within its parent. For an SRD component, the SRD name exactly.
